# Ignore-rule corpus for is_ignored_agrees_with_git_on_corpus.
# Sections: "== <file>" holds the lines of a .gitignore (committed),
# "== @info/exclude" and "== @global" the repository / global excludes,
# "== tracked" paths committed with `git add -f`, "== paths" the paths
# to judge (a trailing / makes a directory on disk). "##" lines are comments.
